edges.reason: Both reports cite a result of 52.8% for the 'No' camp/rejecting the resumption of EU entry talks. They are independent reports from Deutsche Welle and CBS News, both citing the official count from RUV.

edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both quotes report the same result (52.8%) for the 'No' camp/against the proposal in the Iceland referendum. The sources are independent (Deutsche Welle and Reuters).

edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both quotes report the same percentage (47.2%) for the 'Yes' camp in the Icelandic referendum. The sources are independent (Deutsche Welle and Reuters).

spans.value: Icelanders have rejected plans to resume negotiations to join the European Union

edges.label: supports
